metaDescription: Order custom running personal protection equipment for your team or event. Reflective vests, safety gear from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When your team or event involves running in low-light conditions or high-traffic areas, standard safety gear isn't enough. Custom running personal protection equipment combines high-visibility materials with practical designs made for movement. Think reflective vests with moisture-wicking fabrics, lightweight armbands with LED lights, or breathable safety shirts printed with your logo. These items keep runners visible, comfortable, and safe during early morning jogs, charity 5Ks, or corporate fitness challenges. Decoration options include screen printing or heat transfer for logos on vests and shirts.
heroAltText: Custom running personal protection equipment including reflective vests and safety gear for runners
